description: Four converters, each firing a trigger every time a control voltage passes through zero; a polyphonic input gives a trigger per channel

params.text: Sends a trigger from the row's output by hand

inputs.text: Every pass through zero at this input fires a trigger

outputs.text: A 0.1ms 10V trigger each time that row's input passes through zero

notes: A polyphonic cable at a row's input gives that row's output the same number of channels, with a trigger on each channel that passes through zero.
